Battle of Tanga

November 3, 1914 to November 5, 1914

British-Indian amphibious landing at the port of Tanga is defeated by a much smaller German force.

Fought between Britain, India and Germany.

results.name: front-popup
results.question: Open the 1917 to 1918 front
results.popup:
Western Front, March 1917 to March 1918

Shown on the map: March 16, 1917 to March 20, 1918

The front after the German withdrawal to the Hindenburg Line (16 March to early April 1917), as the source map shows it in February 1918, before the German spring offensive of 21 March 1918. The 1917 battles of Arras, Messines, Passchendaele and Cambrai moved parts of it by up to about 10 km, so for spring to December 1917 it is approximate. A US Army map of the front on 21 March 1918 (Truman Library M549) agrees with it to within about 3 km.

Good at Europe or region scale; not for village-level zoom.

Source: The Western Theatre of the European War, 1918 edition, by Prof. B. Barrecchia, published by the Société Editrice Géographique, Paris (scale 1:500,000). Harry S. Truman Library & Museum, M1236
